base_word.note: PR589 tuned word (DreamingOfClouds on eumemic's PR555). Canonical SHA-256 is over the decompressed JSON serialized with sort_keys and separators (',',':'); gzip container bytes are not a mathematical pin.

exporter.note: PR249 record-format exporter (Dylan Crow), used only as an independent cross-check of the record counts; run as a subprocess with -I -B.

identity_source.note: The 3->2 identity is the transvection (Steinberg) relation already used by PR589's tuner and by Dugongue's PR541/PR548 move families on the R480 word. No code is imported from those packages; the window conditions and the ADD-count objective are this package's own.
